I ported the C++ server in `.source/` to Rust 2024. `node check.mjs` builds it and passes all 4 example cases.

**Structure:** it uses only the standard library plus the `libc` crate, which I use just to recognise "too many open files" errors so the server can wait and retry. Like the original, it starts one thread per connection and uses its own small HTTP parser. That keeps the same behaviour on edge cases, such as returning `400` for `/kv/a%20b`, which a framework might decode or normalise di
